svg.title: Repair ladder from diagnose to a professional
svg.desc: Five green steps in order: diagnose the symptom, open the manual, identify the part, try a repair cafe for a small appliance, and call a professional for gas, refrigerant, or mains wiring.
svg.text: Stop at the step that matches the failure
Gas, sealed refrigerant, and mains wiring skip to the last step. Not a wiring diagram.

g.text: 1. Diagnose. Unplug. Write the symptom and the model number.
2. Manual. Manufacturer page first. Match the diagram to the frame.
3. Part. Order the number on the diagram. No price is printed here.
4. Repair cafe. Small appliances, with the volunteer's right to refuse.
5. Professional. Gas, refrigerant circuit, or mains wiring.

svg.text: Green steps are household or community. The grey step is licensed work. Saving Optimizer, 26 Sep 2026.
